name: Well-Justified Event Structures
description: A model based on event structures with a notion of well-justification — inspired by game semantics — used to forbid thin-air values and prove the external DRF guarantee. The authors do not study the soundness of program transformations, but exhibit a load→load reordering counterexample, which also implies that the compilation mappings to ARMv7, ARMv8, and POWER are not optimal.

catSupport.note: Well-justification quantifies over alternative configurations of the event structure (a game-semantics style justification order), which no per-execution cat axiom captures.
